body:
**RAVF001 [high] data semantics** — This adds a second mapping for the same CSVs

The second mapping uses different score units, metric IDs, versions, evaluation IDs, and source metadata.
**RAVF002 [medium] remote input** — The current V2 CSV contains `NullModel`, and this loop writes it as a normal model.
**RAVF003 [medium] error handling** — After handled fetch or write failures print an error and `Done!`, the module exits with status 0.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F001 [medium] filesystem traversal** — `os.walk` ignores scan errors when `onerror` is unset

A readable file can still validate after an unreadable subtree is skipped. The fix uses an `os.walk` error callback to stop partial scans and name the inaccessible path. A mocked scan error test covers this boundary without platform-specific permission behavior.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F001 [medium] API contract** — The docstring calls `output_dir` a collection directory, but supported callers also pass report-identity paths such as `data/lm_eval_samples`.

The corrected docstring describes the parameter as a path below the nearest `data` root. Its relative components form the report name; `data/<collection>` is the usual adapter case.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F002 [medium] report placement** — The nearest ancestor named `data` controls placement

A nested `data` component can leave `adapter_reports` inside an outer datastore tree. The corrected docs state that the nearest `data` ancestor wins. A repeated-`data` example makes the placement limit concrete.
